mapper.select: SELECT USER_PASSWORD_HASH FROM `USER` WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USER_STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN'

SELECT u.USER_ID AS userId, ub.BUTTIE_LEVEL AS buttieLevel, CASE COALESCE(s.RISK_LEVEL, 'STABLE') WHEN 'STABLE' THEN bl.IMAGE_URL_STABLE WHEN 'CAUTION' THEN bl.IMAGE_URL_CAUTION WHEN 'DANGER' THEN bl.IMAGE_URL_DANGER END AS buttieImageUrl, u.USER_NICKNAME AS userNickname, u.USER_NAME AS userName, ep.BIRTH_DATE AS birthDate, u.USER_PHONE_NUMBER AS userPhoneNumber, u.USER_EMAIL AS userEmail FROM USER u JOIN USER_BUTTIE ub ON u.USER_ID = ub.USER_ID JOIN BUTTIE_LEVEL bl ON ub.BUTTIE_LEVEL = bl.LEVEL JOIN EMPLOYMENT_PREPARATIONS ep ON u.USER_ID = ep.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SNAPSHOT s ON ub.USER_ID = s.USER_ID WHERE u.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE `USER` SET USER_NAME = #{user.userName}, USER_EMAIL = #{user.userEmail}, USER_PASSWORD_HASH = #{user.userPasswordHash}, USER_NICKNAME = #{user.userNickname}, USER_PHONE_NUMBER = #{user.userPhoneNumber}, USER_STATUS = #{user.userStatus}, USER_WITHDRAWN_AT = #{user.userWithdrawnAt} WHERE USER_ID = #{user.userId}
UPDATE USER SET USER_NICKNAME = #{user.userNickname}, USER_UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE USER_ID = #{user.userId}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE COALESCE(s.RISK_LEVEL, 'STABLE') WHEN 'STABLE' THEN bl.IMAGE_URL_STABLE WHEN 'CAUTION' THEN bl.IMAGE_URL_CAUTION WHEN 'DANGER' THEN bl.IMAGE_URL_DANGER END AS buttieImageUrl, ub.BUTTIE_LEVEL AS buttieLevel, ub.BUTTIE_TOTAL_EXP AS buttieTotalExp, (SELECT bl2.REQUIRED_EXP FROM BUTTIE_LEVEL bl2 WHERE bl2.LEVEL = ub.BUTTIE_LEVEL + 1) AS requiredExp, COALESCE(s.RISK_LEVEL, 'STABLE') AS riskLevel, u.USER_NICKNAME AS userNickname, u.USER_EMAIL AS userEmail, ep.EMPLOYMENT_PREP_TYPE AS employmentPrepType, ep.PREP_START_DATE AS prepStartDate, ep.TARGET_EMPLOYMENT_DATE AS targetEmploymentDate, (SELECT m.MYDATA_STATUS FROM MYDATA m WHERE m.USER_ID = u.USER_ID ORDER BY m.LAST_SYNCED_AT DESC LIMIT 1) AS mydataStatus, (SELECT MAX(m.LAST_SYNCED_AT) FROM MYDATA m WHERE m.USER_ID = u.USER_ID) AS lastSyncedAt FROM USER u JOIN USER_BUTTIE ub ON u.USER_ID = ub.USER_ID JOIN BUTTIE_LEVEL bl ON ub.BUTTIE_LEVEL = bl.LEVEL JOIN EMPLOYMENT_PREPARATIONS ep ON u.USER_ID = ep.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SNAPSHOT s ON u.USER_ID = s.USER_ID WHERE u.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_BUTTIE (USER_ID, BUTTIE_LEVEL, BUTTIE_TOTAL_EXP) VALUES (#{userId}, 1, 0)
INSERT INTO USER_CONSENTS (USER_ID, TERMS_AGREED_AT, PRIVACY_AGREED_AT, FINANCIAL_INFO_AGREED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE USER_ID = USER_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_BUTTIE ub JOIN ( SELECT c.user_id, c.target_exp, COALESCE(MAX(bl.LEVEL), 1) AS target_level FROM ( SELECT USER_ID, GREATEST(0, BUTTIE_TOTAL_EXP - #{expAmount}) AS target_exp FROM USER_BUTTIE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ) c LEFT JOIN BUTTIE_LEVEL bl ON bl.REQUIRED_EXP <= c.target_exp GROUP BY c.user_id, c.target_exp ) calc ON ub.USER_ID = calc.user_id SET ub.BUTTIE_TOTAL_EXP = calc.target_exp, ub.BUTTIE_LEVEL = calc.target_level

UPDATE USER_BUTTIE ub JOIN ( SELECT c.user_id, c.target_exp, COALESCE(MAX(bl.LEVEL), 1) AS target_level FROM ( SELECT USER_ID, (BUTTIE_TOTAL_EXP + #{expAmount}) AS target_exp FROM USER_BUTTIE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ) c LEFT JOIN BUTTIE_LEVEL bl ON bl.REQUIRED_EXP <= c.target_exp GROUP BY c.user_id, c.target_exp ) calc ON ub.USER_ID = calc.user_id SET ub.BUTTIE_TOTAL_EXP = calc.target_exp, ub.BUTTIE_LEVEL = calc.target_level
